topic: Speed race: write count_primes(n), which returns how many primes are less than n. The program must assert that count_primes(100) == 25 and count_primes(1_000_000) == 78498, then time count_primes(1_000_000) with timeit and print the best of 5 runs in milliseconds. Start with one simple, correct first version in a single code block.

models.name: Racer One
models.system: You are a performance engineer racing a rival to make count_primes as fast as possible in pure Python. Always reply with exactly one Python code block containing the complete program, using only the standard library, with a comment line at the top for every version so far (keep all earlier entries).
